about_intro: We form teams and divisions based on age. We follow US Soccer principles to develop kids — physically, technically, strategically, and grow their Soccer IQ.
about_bullets: Fall: Teams begin practicing mid-August; games run September to early November.
Spring: Teams begin practicing end of March; games run April to mid-June.
volunteer_text: We have trainers who support coaches throughout the season. If you have energy and want to help, we want you.

divisions.schedule: Once per week — accommodates school schedules

divisions_note: All age groups play Saturday mornings between 8:30 AM and noon. Professional Tecnica trainers lead every training session and are present on game days to support coaches and players.
players_bring: Soccer ball (write child's name on it)
Reusable water bottle (write child's name on it)
team_placement_bullets: Teams are chosen at random based on age/grade level/gender.
We cannot accept player, coach, or teammate requests.
We do our best to make teams as fair as possible.
Coaches will reach out to families 1–2 weeks before the season starts.
register_highlight: Please register early. Late registrations cannot be guaranteed team placement or uniforms. Full payment is required to be placed on a waitlist.
waitlist_text:
We run a waitlist when registration approaches our limit for any division. Registering for the waitlist holds your place in line. If you are on the waitlist and we don't assign you to a team by Week 3, you can receive a full refund.

If a division needs coaches, players whose parent volunteers to coach will be given priority on the waitlist.
cta_subtext: June 1 – August 20, 2026  ·  Season starts early September
how_to_register_bullets: Go to the Jackson Soccer Club registration site and choose the program your child will play in.
Existing members: log in to your existing account rather than creating a second one. Creating a duplicate account splits your family's history and delays team placement.
New families: create one household account, then add each child as a participant under that account.
Select the correct program and division for each child, then complete the registration questions.
Read and accept the club waivers and codes of conduct during checkout.
Pay in full to complete registration — a registration is not finished until payment is received.
Upload the required documents (see below). Team assignment cannot happen until these are uploaded.
Watch for a confirmation email. Your coach will contact you 1–2 weeks before the season starts.
required_documents_text: Every player must have two documents on file before they can be placed on a team: (1) proof of age — a birth certificate or passport, and (2) a current color photo of the player's face. Both are uploaded through your registration account. A player will not be assigned to a team until both documents have been uploaded and approved, so please complete this step as soon as you register. If you have already uploaded these documents in a previous season under the same account, you do not need to upload them again unless the club asks you for an updated photo.
